question: List all customers from Delhi
sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE city = 'Delhi'

question: Show products in the Apparel category
sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE category = 'Apparel'

question: Which orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: Show products that cost more than 400
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 400

question: List failed payments
sql: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed'

question: Show reviews with a rating of 5
sql: SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE rating = 5

question: What cities do our customers live in?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ORDER BY city

question: Show the 10 most expensive products
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many customers do we have in each city?
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: What is the average product price per category?
sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category

question: How many products are in each category?
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category

question: What is the total quantity sold per product?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

question: What is the average review rating by product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: How much money was collected by each payment method?
sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS collected FROM payments WHERE status = 'success' GROUP BY payment_method

question: What is the total order value for each order status?
sql: SELECT status, SUM(total_amount) AS total_value FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Which city has the most orders?
sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many reviews have been written in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews

question: What are the highest and lowest order amounts?
sql: SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS highest, MIN(total_amount) AS lowest FROM orders

question: Top 5 products by units sold
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: Which products have an average rating above 4?
sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) > 4

question: What is the average discount per product category?
sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(oi.discount) AS avg_discount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: List order ids with the customer's name and city
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name, c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

question: Show product names with their review ratings
sql: SELECT p.name, r.rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

question: Show the payment method and amount for each order along with the customer name
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name, p.payment_method, p.amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id

question: List customers who have written a review
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN reviews r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id

question: Which customers have never written a review?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN reviews r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.review_id IS NULL

question: Show the products and quantities in order 100
sql: SELECT p.name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = 100

question: Which customers paid by credit card?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_method = 'credit_card'

question: Orders placed in the last 7 days
sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('now', '-7 days')

question: How many orders were placed each month?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Customers who signed up in the last 6 months
sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= date('now', '-6 months')

question: What is the total order value for the last 90 days?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_value FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('now', '-90 days')

question: Which orders shipped more than 5 days after they were placed?
sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, shipping_date FROM orders WHERE shipping_date IS NOT NULL AND julianday(shipping_date) - julianday(order_date) > 5

question: What is the average number of days between ordering and shipping?
sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(shipping_date) - julianday(order_date)) AS avg_days FROM orders WHERE shipping_date IS NOT NULL

question: How much was collected in payments this year?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS collected FROM payments WHERE status = 'success' AND strftime('%Y', payment_date) = strftime('%Y', 'now')

question: Reviews written in the last 30 days
sql: SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE review_date >= date('now', '-30 days')

question: How many new customers signed up each year?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', signup_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

question: Monthly order value for completed orders over the past year
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS order_value FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= date('now', '-1 year') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Products added to the catalog in the last year
sql: SELECT name, category, created_at FROM products WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-1 year')

question: How many orders were placed on each day of the week?
sql: SELECT strftime('%w', order_date) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY weekday ORDER BY weekday
